mcpServer.title: MCP Server Settings
mcpServer.description: Manage Model Context Protocol (MCP) server settings
mcpServer.infoMessage: MCP servers extend AI assistant functionality using the Model Context Protocol. They enable AI assistants to connect with specific services and APIs. For security, available commands and arguments are restricted. Currently, only "uvx" and "npx" commands are allowed, and only MCP servers published on AWS MCP Servers are supported. Using MCP requires deployment option adjustments. Please refer to the documentation for details.
